title: Help a 3-Person Indie Studio Make a Better Game!
author: GoodBoy_GameDevs
selftext:
# Help a 3-Person Indie Studio Make a Better Game!

Hi everyone!

We are a tiny indie team of 3 developers working on our next game, Unleashed. As indie devs deeply inspired by iconic puzzle and atmospheric games, we’re running a research study on player personality and game design.

Because our project shares design philosophies with games like Baba Is You, Gris, Monument Valley, and When the Past Was Around, we want to better understand the players who love these titles. To help us design the best game possible, we’re exploring player personalities using the Big Five framework.

# Check Out Our Game First!

If you're curious about what we're building:

* 🎬 Watch our Game Trailer:[ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWUGo7YrD1U](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWUGo7YrD1U)
* 🎮 Play our Free Demo on Itch.io:[ https://leodomi.itch.io/unleashed](https://leodomi.itch.io/unleashed)

If you’ve played one or more of these games, we would be extremely grateful for your input!

# How You Can Help (~5–10 mins)

Take the Big Five personality test

* [https://bigfive-test.com/it](https://bigfive-test.com/it)

Pick ONE game survey below  
Choose the game you have played.  
(If you’ve played multiple games from the list, choose the one you liked the most!)

* Baba Is You:[ https://forms.gle/iiKkcZV7tE9onVwg7](https://forms.gle/iiKkcZV7tE9onVwg7)
* Gris:[ https://forms.gle/VkYxdh53Ah95SwvF8](https://forms.gle/VkYxdh53Ah95SwvF8)
* Monument Valley:[ https://forms.gle/WL1sXtvajbLo3Zhw7](https://forms.gle/WL1sXtvajbLo3Zhw7)
* When the Past Was Around:[ https://forms.gle/mkxkdQXikw6a6VJy6](https://forms.gle/mkxkdQXikw6a6VJy6)

🔒 Data Privacy: Your data will never be used maliciously or shared with third parties. All responses are completely anonymous and will only be analyzed by our 3-person team to better understand player preferences.

Thank you so much to anyone who takes a few minutes to support our project. Feel free to leave any feedback on our demo in the comments below as well! ❤️
